fusions.name: Nip and Hold
fusions.desc: A quick weapon strike that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Skitter Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks up 3 pebbles at once, each dealing 4 damage. Each pebble that hits stuns its target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scurry
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Cracks in the Wall
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
